phases.title: Freeze Allocation Planning As A Runtime-Owned Lane
acceptance: allocation planning is an explicit runtime lane between 3.6a measurement basis and runtime lowering
planning consumes UiMeasurementBasis rather than re-reading source, host adapters, or Query internals
planning output is inspectable and denial-bearing before mounted receipts exist
phases.instructions: Freeze the planning lane first. Make it a real runtime-owned phase boundary so later layout work cannot hide in execution topology, host helpers, or mounted receipt code.
phases.qa_focus: No second planning path, no source rediscovery, and no mounted-receipt authority sneaking upstream.

phases.title: Define Allocation Neighborhood Authority And Membership
acceptance: UiAllocationNeighborhood is the bounded planning authority artifact
membership derives from graph identity plus measurement dependency map rather than renderer topology or recursion folklore
non-layout participants and incidental repeated-instance order do not silently become neighborhood or peer-group identity
phases.instructions: Turn the 3.6a neighborhood hint into a real planning scope with an explicit equivalence contract and explicit exclusions.
phases.qa_focus: No whole-page default, no hidden participant broadening, and no order- or visibility-shaped identity folklore.

phases.title: Define Constraint Artifacts And Propagation Edges
acceptance: UiLayoutOperatorPlanningContract freezes operator-owned planning semantics for stack, row, grid, split, mosaic, overlay, scroll, and portal_anchor
UiAllocationConstraintSet and UiConstraintPropagationEdge define closed typed propagation families
equivalent neighborhoods emit the same propagation-edge set in canonical order and impossible edge authority denies before solve time
phases.instructions: Freeze the typed planning language before the solver exists. Operators must publish planning contracts instead of private helper behavior.
phases.qa_focus: No opaque solve blob, no unlabeled edge reuse, and no operator-local planning worlds.

phases.title: Propagate Parent Available Space To Children
acceptance: parent available-space propagation is an explicit edge family
axis-specific downward constraints remain typed and preserve normalization posture
contradictory or missing downward constraints deny before later negotiation steps run
phases.instructions: Close the downward path first and keep it separate from sibling negotiation or intrinsic return flow.
phases.qa_focus: No host-pixel reinterpretation, no hidden axis mixing, and no silent override of child bounds.

phases.title: Propagate Child Intrinsic Contributions Back Upward
acceptance: upward intrinsic contribution is its own propagation family
Query-backed and host-backed intrinsic evidence remain distinguishable and generation-compatible
stale or incompatible intrinsic evidence denies before neighborhood solve
phases.instructions: Make intrinsic return flow explicit and evidence-bearing instead of letting widgets or host code re-measure their own meaning.
phases.qa_focus: No anonymous number path, no stale evidence reuse, and no unit or rounding collapse.

phases.title: Solve Sibling Negotiation
acceptance: sibling negotiation is an explicit propagation family with stable group identity
equivalent sibling groups converge on the same negotiation result
unsupported fixed-point or contradictory peer requirements deny structurally before equal-share or bounds reconciliation
phases.instructions: Solve peer negotiation as its own step and record where it sits in solve order so replay and inspection stay honest.
phases.qa_focus: No row or mosaic helper magic, no transient visual order authority, and no hidden fixed-point guessing.

phases.title: Solve Equal-Share Distribution
acceptance: equal-share is an explicit planning family distinct from generic sibling negotiation
UiEqualShareDistributionPolicy defines deterministic remainder handling by stable peer identity
zero-share, zero-space, and single-surviving-peer cases resolve through typed posture rather than leftover-space folklore
phases.instructions: Close equal-share as a real contract with deterministic remainder behavior, not an arithmetic afterthought.
phases.qa_focus: No incidental iteration order, no hidden peer admission, and no divide-by-leftover folklore.

phases.title: Reconcile Min/Max Bounds Without Hidden Fallbacks
acceptance: UiBoundReconciliationPosture distinguishes declared clamp from contradiction
underconstrained, overconstrained, cyclic, stale-input, and unsupported-special-input outcomes remain typed
equivalent bounded inputs converge to the same result or the same typed denial
phases.instructions: Make bound reconciliation honest. A declared clamp can be valid, but silent clamp is not.
phases.qa_focus: No hidden host fallback, no contradiction collapse, and no mixed-posture clamp laundering.

phases.title: Admit Viewport-Derived Planning Inputs
acceptance: viewport basis is a typed special-input planning edge family
viewport input stays planning-time only in 3.6b
missing viewport evidence denies through typed planning posture
phases.instructions: Admit viewport inputs as their own special family without broadening into extent maintenance or continuous churn.
phases.qa_focus: No ordinary parent-child collapse, no raw host bypass, and no portal or scroll bleed.

phases.title: Admit Scroll-Owner Planning Inputs
acceptance: scroll-owner basis is a typed special-input planning edge family
scroll inputs stay planning-time only in 3.6b
missing scroll-owner basis denies through typed posture instead of best effort
phases.instructions: Keep scroll ownership narrow and planning-time here. Do not let host scroll mechanics define semantic ownership.
phases.qa_focus: No scroll behavior broadening, no ordinary propagation collapse, and no host-owned scroll semantics.

phases.title: Admit Portal-Anchor Planning Inputs
acceptance: portal-anchor basis is a typed special-input planning edge family
portal inputs stay planning-time only in 3.6b
missing portal-anchor evidence denies through typed posture instead of hidden fallback
phases.instructions: Keep portal-anchor planning explicit and narrow so later reposition loops consume a real planning seam.
phases.qa_focus: No continuous anchor loop ownership, no ordinary propagation collapse, and no host portal folklore.

phases.title: Admit Durable Resize Inputs Without Making Drag State Authoritative
acceptance: durable splitter-position style state can participate only through an admitted planning seam
transient interaction state alone cannot become layout authority
incompatible carry-forward shape changes deny or remap explicitly
phases.instructions: Freeze the durable resize seam without pulling continuous drag cadence or per-frame commit behavior into this milestone.
phases.qa_focus: No drag-stream authority, no stale durable carry-forward, and no resize folklore hidden in host gestures.

phases.title: Bind Allocation Plan Identity Into Runtime Handle Allocation Basis
acceptance: handle-allocation basis carries allocation-plan identity honestly
changing solved planning while raw topology stays fixed changes the relevant plan-binding identity
handle-allocation basis does not claim committed geometry or receipt truth
phases.instructions: Make the first runtime handoff an identity-carrying compatibility seam, not a premature geometry-commit milestone.
phases.qa_focus: No raw-topology-only digest, no mounted box claims, and no plan/receipt role collapse.

phases.title: Prove Execution Topology Consumes Planning Identity Without Rediscovery
acceptance: execution topology consumes solved planning identity rather than re-solving node meaning
equivalent solved plans lower to equivalent topology and lane partitions
execution topology still does not claim final visible geometry in 3.6b
phases.instructions: Prove anti-rediscovery here. Topology can carry solved planning identity forward, but it cannot reopen layout meaning or mount geometry.
phases.qa_focus: No raw-node reinterpretation, no renderer helper lane partition folklore, and no mounted-geometry creep.

phases.title: Preserve Safe Activation As The Future Commit Boundary
acceptance: changed allocation neighborhoods still commit through ready activation and atomic plan swap
local replanning breadth remains explicit in plan artifacts and counters
candidate planning artifacts do not masquerade as committed mounted truth
phases.instructions: Keep activation as the future commit boundary. Planning may broaden what is activated, but it cannot bypass when activation commits.
phases.qa_focus: No direct active-state mutation, no hidden plan widening, and no candidate-as-committed truth.

phases.title: Make Allocation Planning Inspectable
acceptance: allocation neighborhoods, plans, propagation edges, special inputs, and durable resize posture inspect through the shared evidence substrate
inspection can answer explicit planner questions without widening by default
public inspection converges on the same retained evidence as runtime assembly
phases.instructions: Extend the shared inspection substrate rather than building a planner-local debugger. Keep it refs-first and narrow.
phases.qa_focus: No layout debugger side lane, no presentation-only explanations, and no whole-frame widening by default.

phases.title: Certify Allocation Planning Determinism And Anti-Bypass Boundaries
acceptance: named certification suites prove deterministic planning, anti-bypass boundaries, and bounded neighborhood width
UiAllocationPlanningCostReceipt and solve trace make boundedness and convergence mechanically auditable
host adapters, topology assemblers, and operator-local helpers cannot mint planning semantics outside the admitted lane
phases.instructions: Close 3.6b with proof. The exit bar is that 3.7 can consume one real planning kernel without reopening neighborhood, solver, or handoff semantics.
phases.qa_focus: No certification as substitute authority, no hidden cost sink, and no planner bypass through lower helpers.
